stories.headline: Thinking Machines wants to build an AI that actually listens while it talks
stories.dek: Right now, every AI model you've ever used works the same way. You talk, it listens. It responds, you listen. Thinking Machines is trying to change that by building a model that processes your input and generates a response at the same time, so it's more like a phone call than a text chain.
